name: Pact of the Blade
description:
Use a Bonus Action to conjure a Simple or Martial melee weapon in your hand or bond with a magic weapon you touch. Do not bond a weapon attuned to someone else or bonded to another Warlock. While bonded, you are proficient with it and can use it as a Warlock spellcasting focus. For its attacks and damage, you may use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity. You may choose its normal damage type, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant on an attack.

You may also bind an existing ordinary nonmagical melee weapon; it becomes magical as a Pact weapon. For this test, apply the same Bonus Action and bond-ending rules as the modern Blade baseline. The bond ends when you use this bonding Bonus Action again, the weapon remains more than 5 feet away for one minute, or you die. A conjured weapon then disappears. A physical weapon remains present.
deepenedAtLevel5: At Warlock 5, your Attack action can make two Pact-weapon attacks. This is intrinsic and costs no Invocation. Devouring Blade can later raise this to three total attacks. Thirsting Blade can not be selected; its extra attack is already part of this Pact. Extra Attack features do not automatically add their attack counts together. Weapon Mastery, disarm immunity, and no-throw restrictions are not automatic Blade benefits.
